values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/guernseylake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Guernsey Lake State Forest Campground: 35 campsites, $20, managed by Traverse City SP, phone 231-922-5270), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on Guernsey Lake.

values.note: 35 campsites 'for tents and small trailers', including 8 walk-in sites 100-200 yards from the parking area (pack in/pack out), so 27 drive-in. No length limit posted.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/guernseylake ('offers 35 campsites for tents and small trailers, including 8 walk-in sites', 'There are eight walk-in sites that are 100-200 yards from the parking area'; no maximum length stated, so the 22 ft read from reviewer reports in the note is cleared) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (35 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the north shore of Guernsey Lake (50 acres) among oak and pine hills, 8 mi W of Kalkaska via Island Lake Road and Campground Road (Kalkaska County); managed by Traverse City State Park. Swimming; the Sand Lakes Quiet Area Pathway (8.5 mi, links to the North Country Trail) starts at the campground. Reviewers report rigs up to ~22 ft fitting. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 35 sites incl. 8 walk-in, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (inherited max now confirmed). Cleared max_rig_ft 22 (a reviewer report, not a posted limit). Season (open all year) already manual. Note trimmed of field restatements.
